label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2… supports If c, distinct from x, causes x's being r…
note: ST I q.2 a.3 co. (quarta via) illustrates the maximum's causing what is in its genus by fire, the hottest, causing all hot things: a perfection-causing that is an efficient (heating) causing. The premise states that every causing of another's being r is an efficient causing in respect r. The passage gives one efficient example and does not exclude exemplar or final causes of a perfection, which is exactly where the premise fails.
